systems.name: 6.1 Rendering Optimizations
systems.notes: Profile and optimize CPU/GPU usage. Reduce overdraw, optimize LUTs, and use requestAnimationFrame timing.

systems.name: 6.2 Mobile & Low-End Compatibility
systems.notes: Test on lower-end hardware and mobile devices. Add performance options (lower resolution, simpler lighting).

systems.name: 6.3 Bug Fixing & Regression Testing
systems.notes: Extensive playtesting to catch rendering bugs, collision issues, and gameplay exploits.
